scope: Final compiled local Worker; existing synthetic public/private R2 fixtures; temporary local staff session
checks: Successful public CMS media keeps its explicit one-day public cache policy, no cookies and restrictive media CSP
Public media returns exact single ranges, suffixes and open ranges; invalid ranges return 416; HEAD and conditional requests preserve validators and cache rules
Unauthenticated private files, invalid review grants and missing files are blocked and never cached
Authorized private artwork downloads remain no-store and no-referrer with their stricter CSP intact
Private Range, HEAD and conditional responses work after authorization and remain no-store
Anonymous private Range, HEAD and known-ETag requests cannot disclose metadata, bypass authorization or receive 304/416
Valid customer review grants support private Range/HEAD/revalidation; rotating the grant revokes access before ETag or range processing
